coordinate_policy: Coordinates are modern identification aids only. They must never be interpreted as exact historical positions unless historical_match says otherwise. Every mapped location must carry an explicit precision/confidence classification. Narrative sites with approximate_area coordinates use a deterministic point within an approved radius; the radius is stored explicitly. C/D narrative locations remain coordinate-null unless stronger evidence is established.
